    Ready when you are.

    Only completion is saved on this browser. Never your notes or personal details.

    A small lesson. A useful new perspective.

    Make a control work for everyone

    Choose semantic HTML before adding custom interaction.

    01 / Explore

    The idea, in practice.

    A button already supports focus, Enter and Space. A clickable div does not. Start with a button, give it a clear name, and keep its visible state aligned with its accessible state.

    02 / Make

    A ten-minute experiment.

    Find one interactive control in a project. Check its HTML element, keyboard behaviour and focus indicator. Write down one improvement.

    03 / Reflect

    A quick check-in.

    What is the best starting element for an action that changes the current page?

    A small step. A real start.

    You completed the sample lesson. Keep the question, try another draft, or explore the full curriculum.
